notes.title: Developer's Update
notes.content: [p]Greetings from the Stargazers Studio![/p][p][/p][p]First of all, I want to thank you for sticking around and continuing to support us. I’ve been meaning to share an update for a while now, and I’m writing this to explain why development has slowed down recently.[/p][p][/p][p]To be honest, I’ve been going through some personal issues that made it difficult to stay on track. On top of that..… my wife found out what I was working on. I managed to smooth things over, but it’s been pretty challenging to keep working on the game from home since then.[/p][p][/p][p]I’m really sorry to have kept you waiting this long. That said, we’ve still been steadily working on new content and exciting features behind the scenes. Progress might be slower than I’d like, but I hope you can understand.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you again for your continued interest and patience, it truly means a lot. We’ll be back soon with some good news.[/p][p][/p][p]Sincerely,[/p][p]— The Stargazers Studio Team[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://d2zga2q5hdwcor.cloudfront.net/VR/VR_Developer_update.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Patch Note Version 1.2.0.6335
notes.content:
-Content-
[Tool] A new item, the Mobile Phone (Camera), is now available as a special bonus unlocked after clearing the game successfully.
※ You’re free to take photos—but be warned: if you haven’t built enough intimacy with the secretary, your sneaky shots might earn you a slap. Proceed with caution… and timing.

[Photography Mission] A new photography mission utilizing the Mobile Phone has been added. (Integrated into the progress system)

-System-
[Controller] The Mobile Phone can be accessed by pressing the Y button. (Oculus Quest)
[Controller] You can take a photo using the A button and switch between cameras using the B button. (Oculus Quest)

-Fixes-
[Map] Fixed the lightmap issue on the map.
[Controller] The monologue skip function has been updated from X or A → X. (Oculus Quest)

notes.title: VR Secretary Valentine's Update is LIVE now! ♥️
notes.content:
Valentine’s Day is just around the corner, and here’s a special gift from VR Secretary!
Since we jumped straight into event preparations right after launch, time was a bit tight, so we couldn’t add too many new features this time. However, Ailey’s exclusive Valentine’s outfit will bring a fresh new vibe, hope you enjoy it!

Here are the details of the update.
In addition to the new outfit, we’ve also made improvements based on your feedback.

🎉 Exclusive Valentine's outfits
Limited-Time Valentine’s Special outfits are here for a limited time! Available for only 7 days - don’t miss your chance to see her in this exclusive style! Once the time is up, she’s back to her original look.

🎯 Progress Tracker Added
Want to know how close you are to unlocking all the secrets with Ailey? Now you can track your interactions and uncover hidden surprises as you progress. The more you explore, the more you discover!

🚶‍♂️Controller Movement Added
Now you can move around with the VR controller, even if you’re not moving yourself! Explore freely and interact with Ailey from all angles.
• Use the left stick to move forward, backward, left, and right.
• Use the right stick to adjust your view up and down (note that there's a minimum height limit).

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3384220/VR_Secretary_Ailey_Edition

New outfit update is available ONLY from February 13th to 20th, so hurry up and enjoy this special outfit before it's gone!

notes.title: Valentine Update Incoming
notes.content:
Thank you all so much for your feedback and suggestions on the game. Your criticism and encouragement are what drive us forward.

Based on player feedback, we have planned the content for the next update, which includes:
• Limited-time Valentine's Day outfit
• Progress indicator
• UI optimization

Please look forward to it! We also hope you will continue to share your thoughts and suggestions about our game by leaving a review on Steam.

Our Steam review event is still ongoing, and we warmly invite everyone to participate!
